label: Cabinet / Turkey Red T3 class (5-3/4 × 8 in)
size_source: PSA CardFacts: 1911 T3 Turkey Red cabinet cards measure 5-3/4" x 8" — https://www.psacard.com/cardfacts/baseball-cards/1911-t3-turkey-red-cabinets/123 (146.05×203.2 mm). PSA has a dedicated T3 holder (PSA app lists supersized, T3, and jumbo as oversized types).
back_cues: T3 checklist backs or Turkey Red advertisement / no-offer-text varieties
grader_notes: CGC published max is 2-5/8" × 3-3/4" — T3 is far larger, so CGC is not eligible on the published cap. TAG does not accept oversized/jumbo cards. ARS TCG size caps do not cover cabinets. SGC terms allow an upcharge on cards larger than 3-1/2" × 5-1/2". Confirm BGS current oversized policy before submitting; official current BGS size table was not on the public grading page this turn.
